text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the b-day present! I didn't 
have the matching earrings with Espo-san 
at all, so I'm super stoked~!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
All the accessories from this brand are 
god-tier value. Espo-san, you've got 
amazing taste♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, of course it is. ...Well, if you can 
appreciate that much, then your taste 
ain't half bad either.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind styling you my way, too. 
Consider it a bonus birthday gift.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~ That added value is fire! Ah, 
speaking of coordinating outfits... We're 
dropping limited-edition collab items with 
an apparel brand♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? I gotta buy it, no matter 
what...! Man, you get news fast...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, agility is everything in this world, 
after all~. Umm, ah, here it is, here it 
is... ♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that some super frilly fashion! And 
it's a limited-edition set with an 
outfit?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, of all the collaboration partners, 
I never saw this coming... But dammit... 
this design is actually pretty sick!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Wanna go take a look together then? 
Espo-san and frilly fashion would 
definitely have amazing synergy, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally... Wait, hold on a second?! 
Don't casually make it so that *I'm* the 
one wearing it, hey!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I smell an innovation coming on! I'd 
love to take some notes on your frilly 
Espo-style coordination♪
